# EditShare

> EditShare provides enterprise-grade shared media storage and workflow management solutions for collaborative video production and content creation teams.

EditShare specializes in high-performance NVMe storage systems and cloud-based media management platforms designed for broadcast, film, and digital media production. The product ecosystem includes the EFS storage series, FLOW workflow management tools, and cloud solutions for teams requiring scalable, secure video storage and intelligent ingest-to-delivery workflows.

- EFS Storage Systems

## EFS Storage Systems

- [EFS 410 | Unmatched Media Storage Excellence | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-410): EFS 410: enterprise-grade 15PB+ scalable storage with HA and analytics
- [EFS 310 | High-Performance Media Storage | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-310): EFS 310: high-performance 2.8PB media storage with remote workflows
- [EFS 210 | Compact & Powerful Media Storage | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-210): EFS 210: compact 32TB-432TB scalable media storage with workflow tools
- [EFS 60NL | The Gold Standard in Nearline Storage | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-60nl): EFS 60NL: high-density 1.3PB nearline storage with data protection
- [Ultimate EFS Field | Transform Your On-Set Editing](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-ultimate-field): Ultimate EFS Field: portable NVMe storage for on-set editing and field production
- [EFS 60NL | The Gold Standard in Nearline Storage | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/ultimate-nvme): Ultimate NVMe server for high-performance media and creative workflows
- [EFS MDC | Store Video Footage in the Cloud | EditShare](https://editshare.com/products/efs-storage/efs-mdc): EFS MDC: high-speed metadata controller for cloud video storage operations
